messages:
carla_recon: Heads up — NovaRetail flagged their November invoice showing ~15k fewer embedding units billed than their internal logs. They believe we're undercounting.

ben_billing: do we have invoices already sent? which invoice id?

nina_support: INV-NOVA-20271101 was sent yesterday and customer opened a support ticket. They attached a dump showing ~15,142 embed units missing.
eric_runtime: I'm seeing a spike of late-arrival latency on partition q-4 during shard rotation windows on Nov 12 03:00-03:12 UTC. The emitter has a staleness cutoff of 5m and we dropped events that arrived after cutoff. Example log: 
```
2027-11-12T03:07:21Z node=q-worker-4 request_id=nova-7f2 staleness_ms=324301 emit=false reason=stale_after_cutoff
```

carla_recon: so those requests succeeded but we didn't count them because they arrived late? can you estimate counts for NovaRetail specifically?

eric_runtime: yes. quick query: 
```
SELECT customer_id, count(*) as late_events
FROM raw_request_logs
WHERE customer_id='nova_retail' AND received_at >= '2027-11-12T03:00' AND received_at < '2027-11-12T03:15' AND staleness_ms > 300000
GROUP BY customer_id;
```

eric_runtime: result: late_events = 15,142. Approx tokens per event ~1, so ~15,142 embed_units.

ben_billing: what's our policy for late-arriving meter events? do we normally backfill or credit?

carla_recon: we have precedent to backfill when events are valid and causally lost due to infra rollback. But need approval if invoice already issued.

metering-bot: Alert: emitter-staleness-rate exceeded threshold on q-4 between 03:00-03:15 UTC. staleness_rate=4.1%

eric_runtime: root cause: shard rotation introduced a window where in-flight events were buffered and committed after the emitter's cutoff timer. We'll change the emitter to extend cutoff during rotation, but the immediate step is to replay raw logs and emit missing meter events BF-4011. Estimated time 1 hour.

nina_support: customer is asking for timeline and whether they'll be credited. They want assurance before renewal.

ben_billing: propose: run backfill BF-4011; if it completes and metering topic shows emissions we adjust invoice using invoice amendment code INV-NOVA-20271101-ADJ and notify customer. If backfill fails, issue full credit for missing amount. Approve provisional credit up to $1,700?

carla_recon: estimate $1,514 at current embed rates. approve provisional credit up to $1,800. I'll open FIN-1140.

eric_runtime: starting BF-4011 at 2027-11-12T04:05Z. It will: read raw_request_logs for the affected window, validate payload checksums, and emit meter events with original request_ids.

metering-bot: Backfill BF-4011: started. estimated runtime 45m.

eric_runtime: progress 50% — 7,600 events emitted so far. no checksum mismatches.

nina_support: drafted customer message: "We located a transient timing issue during an infrastructure rotation which caused some of your successful requests to be marked stale in our metering pipeline. We're replaying those events and expect to reconcile the usage within an hour. If reconciliation can't be applied before your invoice reissue window we'll issue an adjustment." ok to send?

ben_billing: send now with BF-4011 ref and FIN-1140. good to set expectations.

eric_runtime: backfill completed at 2027-11-12T05:02Z. emitted 15,142 events. Reconciliation ID: NOVA-RECON-20271112.

metering-bot: BF-4011: success. reconciled_units=15142.

carla_recon: confirmed metering topic shows 15,142 new emit records for nova_retail. running final sanity: 
```
SELECT sum(emitted_units) FROM metered_usage WHERE customer_id='nova_retail' AND reconciliation_ref='NOVA-RECON-20271112';
```

carla_recon: result matches 15,142. Finance: please attach NOVA-RECON-20271112 to INV-NOVA-20271101 and void provisional credit.

ben_billing: will update invoice notes and close FIN-1140. No credit needed since backfill succeeded.

nina_support: customer replied :raised_hands: and thanked the team. They asked what prevents recurrence.

eric_runtime: action items: 1) emitter: increase staleness cutoff during shard rotations; 2) add rotation-safe commit path; 3) alert on staleness spikes. I'll open PRs and reference BF-4011.

carla_recon: thanks — schedule a weekly check for other customers for next 2 weeks. closing thread.
